note: One-click AI edit tools shown in Photo Studio. Each click sends the current image (+ optional mask) with the prompt to the selected edit model (default: Nano Banana). {strength} is replaced by a wording chosen from the Strength slider. Add your own tools here or via the + button.

tools.name: Remove background
tools.prompt: Remove the background completely and replace it with a clean transparent-style solid white background. Keep the subject edges crisp and natural, preserving fine hair and edge detail.

tools.name: Blur background
tools.prompt: Apply {strength} shallow depth-of-field: keep the main subject tack sharp and blur the background with creamy, natural bokeh like an 85mm f/1.4 lens.

tools.name: Studio backdrop
tools.prompt: Replace the background with a professional neutral gray studio backdrop with soft gradient lighting. Keep the subject unchanged with realistic edge blending and matching light direction.

tools.name: Beach at sunset
tools.prompt: Replace the background with a golden-hour beach scene: warm sunset sky, gentle ocean, soft rim light on the subject matching the new environment. Keep the subject unchanged.

tools.name: City at night
tools.prompt: Replace the background with a moody night city street full of colorful bokeh lights. Relight the subject subtly to match the neon environment while keeping their appearance identical.

tools.name: Portrait retouch
tools.prompt: Perform {strength} professional portrait retouching: even out skin tone, reduce blemishes and shine, brighten eyes slightly, whiten teeth naturally. Keep pores and realistic skin texture - no plastic look. Do not change identity, face shape or expression.

tools.name: Magic eraser (mask)
tools.prompt: Remove whatever is inside the masked region and reconstruct the area seamlessly with a photorealistic continuation of the surrounding scene.

tools.name: Remove bystanders
tools.prompt: Remove all background people and passers-by from the photo, keeping only the main foreground subject. Reconstruct the revealed background photorealistically.

tools.name: Fix closed eyes
tools.prompt: Open the subject's closed eyes naturally, matching their eye color and shape from the visible features. Keep everything else identical.

tools.name: Denoise & sharpen
tools.prompt: Clean up sensor noise and compression artifacts, then apply {strength} intelligent sharpening. Preserve natural texture and avoid halos or over-sharpening.

tools.name: Fix blur
tools.prompt: Correct the motion blur and focus softness in this photo, reconstructing crisp realistic detail, especially on the main subject and any faces.

tools.name: Restore old photo
tools.prompt: Restore this old damaged photograph: repair scratches, tears, stains and fading, rebuild missing areas faithfully, and recover natural contrast. Keep the authentic period character - do not modernize faces or clothing.

tools.name: Colorize B&W
tools.prompt: Colorize this black-and-white photograph with historically plausible, naturally saturated colors. Realistic skin tones, believable fabric and environment colors.

tools.name: Enhance detail
tools.prompt: Re-render this image at maximum fidelity: enhance fine detail and micro-texture everywhere as if captured with a high-resolution camera, without changing composition, colors or content.

tools.name: Golden hour
tools.prompt: Relight the scene {strength} as warm golden-hour sunlight: low warm key light, long soft shadows, gentle haze, glowing highlights. Keep subjects and composition identical.

tools.name: Studio relight
tools.prompt: Relight the subject with professional three-point studio lighting: soft key light, subtle fill, crisp rim light for separation. Balanced commercial-photography exposure.

tools.name: Make it pop
tools.prompt: Grade this photo {strength} like a modern editorial shot: deeper contrast, vibrant but controlled saturation, clean whites, rich blacks and subtle clarity boost. No HDR halos.

tools.name: Moody film look
tools.prompt: Apply {strength} a cinematic analog film grade: faded blacks, warm highlights, teal-leaning shadows, fine grain, gentle vignette - like a Kodak Portra / cinema still hybrid.

tools.name: Film noir B&W
tools.prompt: Convert to dramatic black-and-white film noir: deep contrast, hard directional light, moody atmosphere, rich tonal range.

tools.name: Cartoonify
tools.prompt: Redraw this image as a polished modern animated-film style cartoon: clean bold outlines, expressive simplified shapes, vibrant flat shading. Keep the likeness and composition recognizable.

tools.name: Anime style
tools.prompt: Redraw this image in high-quality anime style: cel shading, detailed painterly background, expressive anime features, keeping pose, framing and identity recognizable.

tools.name: Watercolor
tools.prompt: Repaint this image as a delicate watercolor: soft pigment washes, paper texture, loose expressive edges, preserved composition and values.

tools.name: Cyberpunk
tools.prompt: Transform the scene into a cyberpunk world: neon signage, holographic ads, rain-slick reflective streets, dramatic magenta-cyan lighting. Keep the subject recognizable.

tools.name: Expand scene (outpaint)
tools.prompt: Zoom out and expand the scene beyond the current frame in every direction, imagining a wider photorealistic continuation of the environment that matches perspective, lighting and grain. Aspect ratio 16:9.

tools.name: Product shot
tools.prompt: Turn this into a premium e-commerce product photo: seamless soft-gradient backdrop, professional studio lighting, soft realistic ground shadow and reflection, perfectly clean edges.

tools.name: Change season: winter
tools.prompt: Change the season to deep winter: snow-covered surfaces, frost, cold overcast light, visible breath haze - everything else stays identical.
